title: Reasoning Patterns for Efficient AI Coding: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.34943v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces that expose intermediate inference behavior, offering opportunities to study and control reasoning in AI coding. However, the underlying patterns in these traces and their potential for analyzing and guiding coding models remain poorly understood, limiting systematic characterization and inference-time control of LRM reasoning. We conduct an empirical study of reasoning patterns across four representative coding tasks. We transform reasoning traces into structured action sequences and mine recurring fragments using within-task support, cross-task contrasts, and valid--invalid support contrasts. We characterize four general reasoning patterns by coding agents: design-to-implementation for code generation, state tracing for execution reasoning, evidence--fix--recheck for debugging, and semantic mapping for translation. translated_title: 高效AI编码的推理模式：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34943v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型推理模型（LRMs）会生成长篇推理轨迹，揭示其中间推理行为，为研究和控制AI编码中的推理提供了机会。然而，这些轨迹中的底层模式及其在分析和引导编码模型方面的潜力仍知之甚少，限制了对LRM推理的系统性刻画和推理时控制。我们对四个代表性编码任务中的推理模式进行了实证研究。我们将推理轨迹转换为结构化的动作序列，并利用任务内支持、跨任务对比以及有效-无效支持对比来挖掘反复出现的片段。我们刻画了编码智能体的四种通用推理模式：代码生成中的“设计到实现”、执行推理中的“状态追踪”、调试中的“证据-修复-复查”以及翻译中的“语义映射”。我们进一步识别了与编码性能相关的正面和负面推理模式
tldr: 该研究通过将四个编码任务的推理轨迹转化为结构化动作序列进行实证分析，识别出代码生成、执行推理、调试和翻译中的四种通用推理模式及其正负面模式，为系统性刻画和推理时控制大型推理模型提供了依据。
